checks: Frame percentiles retain a 1.5 s long frame, exclude explicitly paused intervals, and do not invent GPU samples
Active warmup and steady-state windows are separate, pause time is excluded, and completion freezes the requested capture
Cancellation retains partial evidence and configuration/resolution changes are visible in exported comparison conditions
Asynchronous GPU queries are attributed to their original frame once, and disjoint queries are discarded with evidence
scope: Unit validation of timing statistics, phased capture and a deterministic GL query facade.
limitations: No real browser, rAF scheduler, WebGL driver or GPU was measured. These checks do not constitute FPS or visual acceptance.
